_rationale: Manual mode: refillTrigger='none' suppresses both the soft floor in the waterfall AND the auto-refill/auto-sweep. Spending drains cash fully (40k/yr from 100k). No surplus → no refill assertion needed (trigger never fires). Cash $100k − $40k = $60k after year 0; Year 1 starts at $60k and so on. Portfolio depletes in year 5 (200k / 40k = 5 years).

breakdownChecks._note: Full spending pull from cash; min floor suppressed under 'none'
